wrong.why: Verse 1:41 says The sons of Anah; Dishon, and Anah here is the son of Zibeon named in 1:40 (Genesis 36:25 agrees), so the Dishon meant is Dishon son of Anah, not Dishon son of Seir.
Verse 1:41 lists Cheran among the sons of Dishon who is the son of Anah (Amram, Eshban, Ithran, Cheran), not the Dishon son of Seir.
Verse 1:41 lists Ithran among the sons of Dishon who is the son of Anah (Amram, Eshban, Ithran, Cheran), not the Dishon son of Seir.

note: No owner-recorded rows in this chapter. The three retargets are one namesake error (Dishon son of Anah recorded as Dishon son of Seir); the 1:17 Meshech-for-Mash and 1:32 concubine-for-wife differences are other-book variants kept, and 1:36 lists Timna among Eliphaz's sons where the site records concubine-of, left alone.
